entry.title: Enterprise Automation & Solution Delivery (EASD) – LFS Services Maintenance from December 01, 2026 10:00-15:00 PCT
entry.content:
THIS IS A SCHEDULED EVENT Dec 1, 10:00 - 15:00 MST

Nov 26, 10:20 MST
Scheduled - Enterprise Automation & Solution Delivery (EASD) – LFS Services Maintenance from December 01, 2026 10:00-15:00 PCT

Release activities will be completed between December 01 2026 from 10:00 - 15:00.
Validation will continue until 02 Dec 2026 15:00
The LFS Team will be releasing software updates that may affect any of the following:

Apps/Services:

Learner Financial Support Management (LFSM)
Fix donor amount and the number of students receiving award on Donor Letter.
fix to update installment status to match assignment status
Fix to remove installments when award amount is reduced
Fix bursary snapshot report to match latest created date of the record to the snapshot date,
Fix bursary snapshot report for multiple disbursement records where first record gets confirmed
Fix Bulk Update award assignment process which incorrectly clears the existing Award Amount when a blank value is supplied, resulting in installment validation failure.
Fix bulk award assignment process where the Created By and Last Updated By fields should display the correct user or system account responsible for creating and updating the installment records, rather than "No User Found 0".
Fix the optional updatable fields in the Bulk Update Assignment file, if no value is provided, or if the provided value is the same as the current value in the matching award assignment, the corresponding field should not be updated. As a result, no updates should be made to any matching award assignment's installment records.
Fix donor letter so that the student should be treated as 1 student recipient, regardless of awarding unit, with the assignment amounts combined into a single recipient entry.
New LFSM Database View for Student T4A Calculation
Add academic calendar, "Previous Co-op Credits Term 1" and "Previous Co-op Credits Term 2","Previous Exchange Credits Term 1" and "Previous Exchange Credits Term 2","Previous Registered Credits Total", "Previous Registered Credits T1","Current Session Class Standing" and "Previous Session Class Standing" , "Administering Unit", field to Award eligibility monitoring,
Add a new column, "ELWD/ELNP/ECSC Effective Date", for Canadian Government Aid Assignments to Award Eligibility Monitoring Report
Fix donor letter template when NOAA letters are generated, donor letter templates: First Time Contact, Award assignment Increase, and Award assignment Update, should display all available Donor Contact Information regardless of Award version or the Award's status.
Enable users to bulk update award assignment by Award Assignment ID

Enable users to bulk update Academic Calendar

Fix to print SPAO Concentration in First Nations on transcripts
Reason for maintenance:

Release of bug fixes and enhancements to LFS
Release Plan: https://confluence.it.ubc.ca/x/A7JVH

entry.title: TelemetryTV Issue - November 16, 2026, 14:16 PCT
entry.content:
Nov 20, 13:25 MST
Resolved - UBC Digital Signage service has been restored. Users are now able to log in and use the system as normal.

Nov 18, 08:56 MST
Update - UBC IT and TelemetryTV continue to work on validation of remediating steps. TelemetryTV users are advised to refrain from accessing the system or making updates at this time, to allow this validation work to conclude.

Nov 17, 10:47 MST
Identified - TelemetryTV has identified the cause of the issue and is actively remediating. There is currently no time estimate available for full restoration of the service.

Nov 16, 14:17 MST
Investigating - We're aware of an issue affecting access to TelemetryTV. All login methods are currently returning an error, and users are unable to access the platform. TelemetryTV is actively working to restore access.

• All login methods are currently unavailable.
• Users are unable to access their accounts or make changes to the platform.
• Existing content saved on digital signage players should continue playing normally while access is being restored.

We're following up with TelemetryTV for further updates. We don't yet have a confirmed timeline for when platform access will be restored, but we'll share more information in this channel as it becomes available.
